faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our studio and services

q1.question: What equipment is included with studio rental?
q1.answer: Our studio comes fully equipped with professional lighting setups, backdrops, reflectors, and basic photography equipment. We also have high-end cameras and lenses available for rent at an additional cost.

q2.question: Can I bring my own equipment?
q2.answer: You're welcome to bring your own cameras, lenses, and specialized equipment. Our studio accommodates various setups.

q3.question: What are the coworking space hours?
q3.answer: Coworking is open 24/7 for monthly members. Day pass users have access from 8 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 6 PM on weekends.

q4.question: Is there parking available?
q4.answer: Yes — free parking available for members and visitors; first-come, first-served.

q5.question: How far in advance can I book?
q5.answer: Studio time can be booked up to 3 months in advance; day passes up to 1 month.

q6.question: What is your cancellation policy?
q6.answer: Studio bookings can be cancelled up to 24 hours before session for a full refund. Day passes can be cancelled up to 2 hours before.

q7.question: Do you offer photography services?
q7.answer: We primarily rent space but can connect you with photographers and host workshops.

q8.question: Is food and drink allowed in the space?
q8.answer: Light snacks allowed in coworking; in studio please keep food in designated areas to protect equipment.
